behavior: The watcher reports each repository's raw size and the fleet sum, and a Grafana rule fires above 80% of the declared free tier (AC2 prerequisite, Q3)

The rendered R2 tfvars give one bucket per backup.sources node, lock data/ snapshots/ keys/ config and never locks/ or index/, keep R below the --keep-within days, and the retention flags forbid repacking with --max-repack-size 0 (AC2)
SECRET_CATALOG declares a distinct R2 key pair and restic password per node plus one read-only watcher pair, and the mint command writes them without printing them (AC1)

No two nodes render the same bucket, key pair or restic password in backup.yml, backup_destination or the watcher targets; the watcher Secret, the declared exception, carries one Object Read pair distinct from every node's pair plus each node's restic password taken from that node's own SOPS key (AC1); each minted token's requested policy names exactly one bucket, and the watcher's names exactly the node buckets (AC3)
A prune refused after a successful backup does not fail the ship; it is reported on its own signal, and a failed backup still fails it (AC3, Q6)
The migration copies, compares snapshot count and oldest time, reinitialises the marker with its journal line, ships and re-pins, stopping at the first mismatch (AC4)

On the scratch bucket under a 1-day lock: two backups and check succeed with locks/ outside the rule; --max-repack-size 0 takes the dry-run repack list from at least one pack to none; forgetting a snapshot younger than R is refused by R2 at the snapshot's DELETE; a prune of unreferenced packs younger than R is refused at the pack's DELETE; a direct young data/ delete is refused; and the same forget is accepted once everything is older than R (AC2, AC3)
